facts.text: Under the Future-Ready Transfer Scholarship, qualifying transfer students entering a bachelor's program with at least 6 transferable credits can receive up to $7,168 in tuition savings.

sources.title: Future-Ready Transfer Scholarships for College Students
sources.quote: Bachelor students: Minimum of 6 transferable semester credit hours Up to $7,168 in scholarship savings1 To qualify, transfer students must: Be a new or readmit student Be enrolled in a DeVry bachelor's program
